rubric_items.reason: The design uses only existing layers: router, service, repo, client.ts, PatientsPage and the existing index. It adds no endpoint, migration or infrastructure. It follows the UTC/HOSPITAL_TZ rule and the list envelope rule.

S-1 to S-4 each map to components, and every AC is covered. That includes latest COMPLETED, the Asia/Kolkata date with an AC3 API test, '-' for null, unchanged paging/search/sort/Next, no sort option, no highlight and no medical columns.
Method and path are exact. last_visit is exact: string | null, YYYY-MM-DD in HOSPITAL_TZ. JSON and TS shapes are given for both row types, and HOSPITAL_TZ is passed as a bound parameter.

Prior F-1 is resolved. The row-type locations are now explicit Assumed entries with their basis. api/src/types.ts is cited through C17, and Implement must confirm the type name and the web file. The other choices are cited.
Five trade-offs, each with a reason and a cost, including the picker latency cost of reusing the endpoint.
Clear and consistent. The frontmatter components and endpoints match the body sections.
